name: DCA Poultry Palace (Pixar Pier) Chicken Drumstick Box or Jumbo Turkey Leg (Peel Skin, Skip Slaw)
brandOrRestaurant: Poultry Palace (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Three juicy roasted/seasoned chicken drumsticks or a smoked turkey leg provide quick, high-protein fuel right on Pixar Pier once you peel away the spiced skin and skip the coleslaw.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel the seasoned skin off the drumsticks and discard the cup of raw cabbage coleslaw (avoid the chili-lime corn on the cob).
watchOuts: Never order the Chili-Lime Corn on the Cob (whole corn hulls + lime juice + chili powder)
